name: Generativity
description: Best reliably produces frames that shift the problem. Evidence: frame worths from the blind study and the frames in the digest.

name: Teachability
description: Best can be run by a breeding team of 4 to 10 from the written protocol alone. Evidence: stuck points, interpretation notes, and how the reference team fared.

name: Robustness
description: Best gives similar quality across executors and trials. Evidence: differences between the cross-pair and reference-team runs, and between Trial 1 and Trial 2.

name: Perspective reach
description: Best has explicit steps that reach non-human and marginal human perspectives, and these steps did work in trials.

name: Local and global coherence
description: Best checks both local and global properties and handles conflicts between them. Evidence: steps and trial outputs.

name: Traceability
description: Best lets a reader trace each frame back to evidence, steps and perspectives.

name: Economy
description: Best achieves its results with the least time and effort for a real team, relative to what it produces.
